sentences.en: Last week, when President Trump raised tariffs against China to an astonishing 145%, he radically changed the cost of doing business for thousands of American companies.

sentences.en: So much so, in fact, that many of those companies may not survive.

sentences.en: And so I filled her in and, you know, she's feeling hopeless and helpless with me now.
sentences.zh: 我把情况告诉了她，你知道，她现在跟我一样感到绝望和无助。

sentences.en: I want to start by having you tell us the story of your company.
sentences.zh: 我想先请你给我们讲讲你的公司故事。

sentences.en: And just to begin, tell us the name of the company and then tell us the story of how you went about creating this company.

sentences.en: So my name is Beth Benecke, and I am the CEO and founder of Busy Baby.
sentences.zh: 我叫贝丝·贝内克，是Busy Baby公司的首席执行官兼创始人。

sentences.en: I grew up in southern Minnesota, the daughter of an entrepreneur.
sentences.zh: 我在明尼苏达州南部长大，是一位企业家的女儿。

sentences.en: My dad has a small business.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸经营着一家小企业。

sentences.en: He's a welder.
sentences.zh: 他是一名焊工。

sentences.en: So I grew up in his business, and I grew up wanting to have my own business as well.
sentences.zh: 我是在他的生意中长大的，我也从小就想拥有自己的事业。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: What was it about watching your dad have a business that made you want to?
sentences.zh: 看着你父亲经营生意，是什么让你也想这样做？

sentences.en: It was the freedom.
sentences.zh: 是那种自由。

sentences.en: It was the being able to leave work and come to my softball games and choose the work he
sentences.zh: 能够离开工作去参加我的垒球比赛，选择他想做的工作，

sentences.en: wants to do and turn away the work he doesn't want to do, being in control of your own destiny.

sentences.en: But what he always told me is, you know, you really got to be passionate about what you're
sentences.zh: 但他总是告诉我，你必须对你所做的事情充满热情，

sentences.en: doing because when hard times hit, and they absolutely will, if you're not passionate about what you're doing, you're not going to make it.

sentences.en: But so when I finished, graduated high school, I wasn't passionate about anything other than not going to college.

sentences.en: I tried it, and it wasn't a big fan, and a recruiter called me out of the blue, and I ended up joining the military.

sentences.en: So I joined the Army.

sentences.zh: 我说服了我哥哥也去参军，所以我们在欧洲一起服役。

sentences.en: We deployed to the war in Iraq, and we started in Kuwait before the war started.
